items.text: The legal age for cannabis in Yukon is 19. Adults may carry up to 30 g of dried cannabis (or equivalent) in public, and buy from private licensed stores, in person and online.

Cannabis must be used in a private residence and its adjoining property (house and yard), or another place the regulations allow. Using it in public can bring a warning, seizure of the cannabis or a ticket. In a vehicle, keep it in a closed container out of reach of the driver and passengers; don't drive a vehicle, snowmobile, quad or boat after using it.
In Yukon people under 19 are minors for alcohol, so the legal drinking age is 19.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Treat the Yukon as the homelands of 14 First Nations: learn customs before visiting communities, ask permission as you would at someone's home, visit cultural centres and use First Nations guides. Pack out all rubbish and keep land and water clean.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Respect the land and animals; don't mock animals. Follow community guidance on sacred and private places.
